title: DecisionLedgerSeal
description: Additive tamper-evidence + authenticity envelope over an existing DecisionLedgerEntry. Does NOT modify DecisionLedgerEntry (which stays additionalProperties:false); it references the entry by decision_id and commits to its content via entry_hash. Plugs verified estate gaps: the ACR decision ledger is append-only by convention but has no hash-chain, no fork detection, no cryptographic signature, and no idempotency key. A seal supplies all four. Every entry whose canonical_mutation=true SHOULD carry a seal (see contract-pack invariant decision_ledger_is_tamper_evident).

chain_id.description: Per-scope chain (default 'acr:' + canonical-entity or resolution scope). Per-scope chains avoid a single global serialization bottleneck.

seq.description: Strictly increments per chain_id; two seals citing the same prev_seal_hash in a chain = detected fork.

entry_hash.description: hash_alg over canon(the referenced DecisionLedgerEntry). Commits the seal to exact entry content (tamper-evidence).

prev_seal_hash.description: entry-independent chain link: hash_alg over canon(previous seal in chain_id), or 'GENESIS' for the first.

idempotency_key.description: hash_alg over canon([decision_id, policy_version, sorted(input_hashes)]). Equal keys => the same decision; a replay does not create a second canonical mutation.

policy_hash.description: Optional content-hash of the exact policy pack applied (stronger than DecisionLedgerEntry.replay.policy_version string). Enables byte-exact replay.

hash_alg.description: Estate hash-seal standard. E1: confirm against the estate canonicalizer in WO_FIBER_001.

alg.description: ed25519 single-signer, or ed25519-frost for threshold/quorum seals (high-blast-radius decisions: merge/split/canonical_promoted).

merkle_checkpoint.description: Optional periodic global tamper-evidence: a Merkle root over all active chain heads, giving cross-chain anchoring without cross-chain contention.

created_at.description: Advisory wall-clock; ordering is by seq/chain, not this field.
